_doc: Curated routing hints for every skill in upstream.lock.json. tools/build.py renders skills/lyra/SKILL-MAP.md from this file and fails if a locked skill is missing here. effects: none | files | subagents | git | tracker | browser | installs | code.

skills.name: grilling
skills.hint: Interview in rounds to stress-test a plan, decision or idea; each round builds on the last answers.

skills.name: grill-me
skills.hint: User-only wrapper: calls grilling. Route to grilling instead.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.hint: User-only wrapper: calls grilling and domain-modeling. Route to those two instead.

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.hint: Challenge terms against GLOSSARY.md, code and ADRs; record resolved terms and ADRs.

skills.name: brainstorming
skills.hint: Find out what to build and why, lay out approaches, write and get approval for a design doc. Skip when the request is already clear.

skills.name: to-questionnaire
skills.hint: User-only: turn a decision you cannot answer into a questionnaire for someone else.

skills.name: wait-what
skills.hint: User-only: re-pitch a message that did not land.

skills.name: research
skills.hint: Investigate against primary sources; write a cited Markdown report. Quick lookups stay in chat.

skills.name: teach
skills.hint: User-only: teach a concept through a workspace of lessons and references.

skills.name: writing-plans
skills.hint: From an approved spec or requirements, write a task-by-task implementation plan. Use directly when a spec is approved.

skills.name: to-spec
skills.hint: User-only: synthesize the conversation into a spec and publish it to the issue tracker.

skills.name: to-tickets
skills.hint: User-only: split a plan or spec into tracer-bullet tickets with blocking edges.

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.hint: User-only: chart a huge, foggy effort as decision tickets and resolve them one at a time.

skills.name: triage
skills.hint: User-only: move incoming issues and PRs through triage roles.

skills.name: setup-matt-pocock-skills
skills.hint: User-only: one-time repo setup (tracker, labels, doc layout) for Matt's engineering skills.

skills.name: executing-plans
skills.hint: Execute a written plan inline, task by task.

skills.name: subagent-driven-development
skills.hint: Execute a plan with implementer and reviewer subagents.

skills.name: dispatching-parallel-agents
skills.hint: Two or more independent tasks with no shared state.

skills.name: implement
skills.hint: User-only: implement one spec or ticket (drives tdd and code-review).

skills.name: implement-spec
skills.hint: User-only: implement a whole spec and its tickets with parallel subagents on one branch.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.hint: Test-first for any feature or bugfix; the superpowers flow's TDD.

skills.name: tdd
skills.hint: Test-first in vertical red-green slices; Matt's flow's TDD. Pick one TDD skill, not both.

skills.name: prototype
skills.hint: Throwaway prototype (logic HTML or UI) to answer a design question.

skills.name: wizard
skills.hint: Generate a bash wizard for steps only a human can do (dashboards, secrets).

skills.name: using-git-worktrees
skills.hint: Create an isolated workspace before feature work or plan execution.

skills.name: codebase-design
skills.hint: Vocabulary and method for designing deep module interfaces and seams.

skills.name: improve-codebase-architecture
skills.hint: User-only: scan for deepening opportunities, HTML report, then grill one.

skills.name: systematic-debugging
skills.hint: Any bug, test failure or unexpected behaviour, before proposing fixes.

skills.name: diagnosing-bugs
skills.hint: Hard bugs and performance regressions: build a tight pass/fail loop first.

skills.name: diagnosing-superpowers
skills.hint: Why a superpowers session went wrong (repeats, cost, skipped skills).

skills.name: code-review
skills.hint: Review changes since a fixed point on Standards and Spec, two parallel subagents.

skills.name: requesting-code-review
skills.hint: Ask a reviewer subagent to check finished work before merging.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.hint: Handle review feedback with technical rigor before changing code.

skills.name: verification-before-completion
skills.hint: Run the checks before claiming work is done, fixed or passing.

skills.name: finishing-a-development-branch
skills.hint: Decide how to integrate finished work: merge, PR, clean up.

skills.name: pr
skills.hint: Write a PR body: smallest visual, evidence, door call.

skills.name: retro
skills.hint: User-only: look back on a session and improve the agent's environment.

skills.name: handoff
skills.hint: User-only: compact the conversation into a handoff doc in the OS temp dir.

skills.name: writing-for-agents
skills.hint: Write or edit skills, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md.

skills.name: writing-skills
skills.hint: Create, edit and test skills before deployment.

skills.name: ask-matt
skills.hint: User-only router over Matt's skills. Lyra already routes; mention it when the user wants Matt's own map.

skills.name: using-superpowers
skills.hint: Superpowers bootstrap. Not exposed by default: Lyra's intake replaces its start-up rule.

skills.name: chief-of-staff
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: delegate to fresh subagents and keep a dated wiki.

skills.name: claude-handoff
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: hand the conversation to a fresh background agent.

skills.name: loop-me
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: grill the user about specs for workflows.

skills.name: setup-ts-deep-modules
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: dependency-cruiser deep modules for a TS repo.

skills.name: writing-beats
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: assemble raw material into beats.

skills.name: writing-fragments
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: mine raw writing fragments.

skills.name: writing-shape
skills.hint: User-only, in progress: shape raw material into an article.

skills.name: git-guardrails-claude-code
skills.hint: Frozen misc: Claude Code hooks that block dangerous git commands.

skills.name: migrate-to-shoehorn
skills.hint: Frozen misc: replace `as` in tests with shoehorn.

skills.name: scaffold-exercises
skills.hint: Frozen misc: scaffold course exercise folders.

skills.name: setup-pre-commit
skills.hint: Frozen misc: Husky + lint-staged pre-commit hooks.

overlaps: Interview: grilling stress-tests a plan the user already has; brainstorming discovers what to build. Pick one per need.
TDD: test-driven-development in the superpowers flow, tdd in Matt's flow. One per task.
Debugging: systematic-debugging for any bug; diagnosing-bugs when a bug resists and needs a feedback loop.
Review: code-review reviews a branch against standards and spec; requesting-code-review asks for a review of your own finished work.
Plans: writing-plans writes a plan file; to-spec and to-tickets publish to an issue tracker (user-only).

host_kits._doc: Skill kits other plugins provide (not in upstream.lock.json). Keep kits empty in the public repo; put private kits in ~/.lyra-4d/host-kits.json as {"kits": [{"name", "entry", "mcp_prefix", "skills": [{"name", "hint", "effects"}]}]}.
guidance: Some sessions list skills and MCP tools from other plugins (domain or company kits). Lyra does not pin or install them; the session's own list is the truth.
Same gate as any skill: read-only tools may gather context while diagnosing; name the kit's skills in the DETAIL workflow, its own intake or workflow skill first; invoke them after confirmation.
Private kit names go in ~/.lyra-4d/host-kits.json; the installer adds them to the installed copies of this map only.
